# @lab900/forms

> Schema driven reactive forms for Angular 22+, built on Angular Material. You describe the form as a
> `Lab900FormConfig` of typed fields and `<lab900-form>` builds the `FormGroup` and renders every field.

Fields are config objects from the `Lab900FormField` union, picked by their `editType`. Titles, placeholders
and most options are reactive: a value, a function of the form value, or a signal. Labels are
`@ngx-translate/core` translation keys. Import every symbol from `@lab900/forms`.

## Docs

- [Instructions for AI agents](https://lab900.github.io/angular-library-forms/guides/AGENTS.md): setup, rules, every edit type with examples, common mistakes
- [Getting started](https://lab900.github.io/angular-library-forms/guides/getting-started.md): installation and theming
- [Creating forms](https://lab900.github.io/angular-library-forms/guides/creating-forms.md): the schema, nesting, conditions and validation
- [Changelog](https://lab900.github.io/angular-library-forms/CHANGELOG.md): changes per version, breaking changes included

## Optional

- [Full reference](https://lab900.github.io/angular-library-forms/llms-full.txt): the agent instructions plus the inputs, outputs and config fields of every public symbol
